notes: Prove the public polarity of the World Cup Soccer Fliptronic cabinet flipper-button optos (public 112 lower right, 114 lower left) on GEN_WPCSECURITY. Direct switch writes only, so PinMAME keyboard handling, the flipper-key path, and the built-in simulator stay off. The coin-door switch and the five normalized trough optos are presented closed, credits are added through coin switch 1, the fresh-NVRAM notice is cleared through Begin Test and three Escapes, and a game is started; once the trough eject (public solenoid 6) proves a game is running, each button address is held at public level 1 and then released while the lower flipper outputs 45-48 are recorded. The driver declares FLIP_SOL(FLIP_L), so 45-48 carry the ROM's own Fliptronic flipper-coil writes rather than PinMAME's synthetic button-derived states. This scenario proves emulator-facing polarity and causality only, not physical opto construction or coil force.
